goal: Add a System Admin surface (manage all users: list, view, change plan free<->paid, view payment history) and a Bakong KHQR payment integration for plan upgrades, on top of the existing Rayu accounts platform.

backend.orm: Prisma 6 (MySQL in prod, validated string-union enums at API layer)
backend.auth: Clerk session -> Rayu JWT (access/refresh). RayuAuthGuard + RolesGuard already exist. Roles: user|admin|superadmin.
backend.validation: global ValidationPipe (whitelist + forbidNonWhitelisted + transform); DTOs via class-validator

frontend.framework: Next.js (app router, client components use 'use client')
frontend.auth: Clerk (ClerkProvider). Browser exchanges Clerk token for Rayu access token via POST /api/web/session, then calls API with Bearer.

payment.sdk: bakong-khqr (npm) wrapped by github.com/Choeng-Rayu/-bakong_js; BakongKHQR + IndividualInfo + khqrData + checkTransactionByMD5
payment.note: Server-side only. Generate QR+md5, persist Payment(pending), poll/verify by md5, on success activate paid Subscription.

flow.adminUserMgmt: Admin opens /admin -> web/session yields Rayu token -> GET /api/admin/users (paginated, roles-gated) -> view user detail incl. plan + payments -> PATCH /api/admin/users/:id/plan to set free|paid plan code.
flow.userUpgrade: User on /plans (or /billing) clicks upgrade -> POST /api/payments/khqr {planCode} -> backend creates Payment(pending) + returns {paymentId, qr, md5, amountCents} -> frontend renders QR -> polls GET /api/payments/:id/status -> backend calls Bakong checkTransactionByMD5 -> on PAID: mark Payment paid, switch active Subscription to the paid plan -> frontend shows success.

constraints: All admin endpoints MUST be behind RayuAuthGuard + RolesGuard @Roles('admin','superadmin').
Bakong secrets are server-side only; never expose BAKONG_DEVELOPER_TOKEN to the browser or in API responses.
Plan activation MUST be driven by a verified Bakong transaction, never by the client claiming success.
Reuse existing primitives: User.role, Subscription, Payment table, PLAN_CODES, RolesGuard, AuthService.webSession, apiUrl helper.
Keep enums as string-unions in src/common/enums.ts (no Prisma native enums) for SQLite-test compatibility.
Money in integer cents; Bakong amount conversion handled server-side (USD plan price -> KHR/USD KHQR amount).
